title: Cell Culture Cherry Picking with CSV File
author: Opentrons
materials: Find location on Corning 96-well Plate (Cat. CLS3596-50EA)

steps.title: Prepare CSV file and set mount
steps.instruction: Upload a .csv file that includes a header line, using well names without a leading zero (e.g., "A1" not "A01"); then specify which mount (left or right) will hold the P300 pipette.

steps.title: Transfer media for each sample
steps.instruction: For every well listed in the CSV, perform the following actions:

substeps.instruction: Pick up one Opentrons 96 filter tip (200 µL) from the 96 Filter Tip Rack using the P300 Single‑Channel pipette (20‑300 µL).
Find the location of the source well on the Perkin Elmer 384‑well plate (Catalog 6007658).
Mix and aspirate 50 µL of Cell Culture Media, leaving an air gap.
Find the location of the destination well on the Corning 96‑well plate (Catalog CLS3596-50EA).
Dispense the 50 µL of Cell Culture Media into the destination well.

steps.title: Discard used filter tip
steps.instruction: After completing the transfer for a sample, discard the used Opentrons 96 filter tip (200 µL) into the trash.
